enchantments.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Resistance +6: Passive: +6 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.
Efficient Metamagic - Empower Healing II: The additional spell point cost for using the Empower Healing Metamagic feat is reduced by 2 SP.
Vitality +20: Passive: +20 Vitality bonus to Hit Points.
Amaunator's Blessing: When all three items from the set are equipped, you will gain a 10% Enhancement discount to the Spell Point cost of all your spells.
